content: Obsidian Web Clipper pipeline: Defuddle for article extraction (successor to Mozilla Readability, handles SPAs Readability misses) + Turndown + Joplin GFM plugin for tables/strikethrough/task-lists/fenced code. Code snippets detected and preserved in fenced blocks with language tags; preserves br/span newlines in code paths; preserves math/footnotes/images. MarkDownload/MarkSnip use Turndown+Readability. This is the standard proven clipper stack for F6.
